visualContract.density: broad calm masses; sparse purposeful clusters

layers.rule: Continuous pasture base. Avoid repeating a single visible motif in a regular cadence.
State patches are authored overlays and are placed sparsely over the base pasture; V2 contains no full-diamond brown slab.
Use path ribbons and irregular compacted patches over base pasture. Align connector endpoints; keep outside pixels transparent. Vary segments deterministically.

Place a subtle wear patch below ground-contact anchors for tractors, cattle clusters, house approaches and high-use gates. Use asset-authored contact shadows where supplied; do not draw replacement sprites with primitives.

transitionLogic.grassToDirt: Lay the alpha road overlay over base pasture; use the built-in irregular grass/soil fringe as edge breakup. Avoid square tile boundaries.
transitionLogic.wornGround: Place compacted patch as a low-opacity-independent authored decal at a reduced visual scale; alpha itself defines its footprint.
transitionLogic.dryMudCultivated: Legacy candidates remain excluded until regenerated or reviewed against V2 palette. No production use while art review is pending.
transitionLogic.dryState: Use dry-pasture patch as sparse alpha decal over the base; do not replace whole pasture fields with uniformly brown tiles.
transitionLogic.mudState: Use the muddy patch only near troughs, gates and high-traffic corral edges; keep wet highlights subdued and localized.
transitionLogic.legacy: Legacy full-diamond dry/mud/worn/cultivated soil candidates stay in the manifest for provenance but are excluded from V2 art composition. The new V2 family uses alpha overlays and the reviewed base grass.
transitionLogic.cultivatedState: Use cultivated patch as a sparse alpha overlay or masked area; legacy full-diamond cultivated tile remains excluded from V2 until reviewed for edge continuity.

placementRules.depth: render terrain and decals first, then props ordered by ground-contact anchor
placementRules.scale: Use manifest scaleHints.preferredRenderSizePx with projected subcell 64x32 px: render dimensions equal [64*(footprint.x+footprint.y), 32*(footprint.x+footprint.y)]. A 128x64 base tile is 2x2 subcells. Current footprints: ground 9x9 (1152x576), road overlay 4x4 (512x256), localized state patches 2x2 (256x128). Apply one uniform transform from source PNG.
placementRules.repetition: seeded segment selection, avoid repeated motifs and obvious 3x3 cadence
placementRules.approval: candidate assets require human art review, alpha-matte inspection, scene-fit and connector/repeat review before promotion
